prompt: Write a list of years, beginning with 1924 and increasing in increments of 10 to the year 2014, and for each year, write a list of 3 notable works that were originally published in that year (the works can be books, movies, TV shows, music, video games, or any other type of work). After the 3 works, write something that explains how old the works will be in 2024 (e.g. a work published in 1974 will be 50 years old in 2024, and a work from 2004 will be 20)
judge_reasoning: Perception scan found N=4 candidates: [1] “Here's a list of notable”, [2] “Here's the list of notable”, [3] “Here's the list of years”, [4] “1924: 1. \"The Waste”. All candidates follow the required structure of listing years 1924→2014 (step 10), giving 3 works per year, and stating their age in 2024. Candidate [1] has only a few clearly incorrect publication-year claims (e.g., “Death on the Nile” and “The Big Sleep”), while [2], [3], and especially [4] include many more mismatched works for the target years (e.g., Gatsby placed in 1924; multiple works placed in wrong decades; “The Waste Land” placed in 1924). Therefore [1] is the strongest overall despite minor inaccuracies.
